ValidationRule.description: If the 5x5 Coverage checkbox is true then mark Percentage Step 0 - 3 and Premium Rate 5x5 as required.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(Is_5X5_Coverage__c = true, OR(ISNULL(Percentage_5X5_Step_0__c), ISNULL(Percentage_5X5_Step_1__c), ISNULL(Percentage_5X5_Step_2__c), ISNULL(Percentage_5X5_Step_3__c), ISNULL(Premium_Rate_5X5__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If 5x5 Coverage is checked, then Percentage 5x5 Step 0 - 3 and Premium Rate 5x5 is required.
